<style>/* Onboarding chrome + brand theme. Injected after the shared styles/app.css
   (only on this page), so the :root block below re-points the --dlt-* tokens to
   the official dltHub palette without affecting app.py. Values mirror the web
   client's design tokens (runtime/clients/web globals.css). */
:root {
  /* dltHub brand */
  --dlt-aqua: oklch(0.7 0.1 215);            /* #59c1d5 */
  --dlt-lime: oklch(0.81 0.18 115);          /* #c6d300 */
  --dlt-green: oklch(0.65 0.15 135);         /* action / "run" */
  --dlt-dark-purple: oklch(0.16 0.06 285);   /* #191937 */
  --dlt-medium-purple: oklch(0.28 0.09 285);
  --dlt-light-purple: #5c57c6;               /* primary */
  --dlt-lightest-purple: oklch(0.73 0.08 285);

  /* semantic — same names the rest of this file & app.css already reference */
  --dlt-bg: #f9f9fb;
  --dlt-card: oklch(1 0 0);
  --dlt-border: oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32);
  --dlt-border-soft: oklch(0.95 0.003 286);
  --dlt-secondary: #ecedf1;
  --dlt-danger: #ee5a51;
  --dlt-accent: var(--dlt-light-purple);
  --dlt-accent-soft: color-mix(in oklch, var(--dlt-lightest-purple) 22%, transparent);
  --dlt-accent-ink: var(--dlt-light-purple);
  --dlt-accent-fg: oklch(0.985 0 0);
  --dlt-text: var(--dlt-dark-purple);
  --dlt-muted: oklch(0.45 0.04 285);
  --dlt-radius: 6px;
  --dlt-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
  --dlt-card-border: 1px solid var(--dlt-border);
  --dlt-font: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --dlt-font-mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
}

#App.config-width-full > div > div { padding-left: 0 !important; padding-right: 0 !important; }
#App { padding-left: 0; padding-top: 0; background: var(--dlt-bg); box-sizing: border-box; }
#App .marimo-cell { background: transparent !important; border-radius: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; margin: 0 !important; }

/* ---- Page header (centered title + subtitle) ---- */
.page-head { text-align: center; margin: 0; }
.page-title {
  font-family: var(--dlt-font);
  font-size: 30px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--dlt-text); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0 auto; max-width: 700px;
}
.page-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--dlt-font);
  font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--dlt-muted); margin: 14px auto 0; max-width: 560px;
}
/* ---- Results (rendered inside the query card once a query runs) ---- */
.dlt-section-label {
  font-family: var(--dlt-font);
  font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dlt-text);
  margin: 4px 0 10px;
}
.res-block { padding: 2px 2px 0; }
.res-empty {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 300px; text-align: center;
  font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--dlt-font); color: var(--dlt-muted);
}
.run-hint {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  font: 600 13px/1 var(--dlt-font); color: var(--dlt-accent-ink);
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: var(--dlt-accent-soft); padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 6px;
}
.run-arrow {
  font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;
  animation: nudge 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes nudge {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  50% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
}
@keyframes fade-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .run-arrow { animation: none; }
}

/* ---- loading skeleton (while the playground read resolves) ---- */
.dlt-skeleton {
  display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: stretch; flex-wrap: wrap;
  animation: fade-in .25s ease;
}
.sk-pane {
  background: var(--dlt-card); border: var(--dlt-card-border);
  border-radius: var(--dlt-radius); box-shadow: var(--dlt-shadow);
  padding: 18px 20px; box-sizing: border-box;
}
.sk-schema { flex: 1 1 300px; min-width: 260px; }
.sk-workspace { flex: 3 1 480px; min-width: 320px; }
.sk-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 11px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dlt-border-soft);
}
.sk-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.sk-dot { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 5px; flex: none; }
.sk-line { height: 11px; border-radius: 5px; }
.sk-w30 { width: 30%; } .sk-w40 { width: 40%; } .sk-w55 { width: 55%; } .sk-w70 { width: 70%; }
.sk-block { height: 120px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.sk-block.tall { height: 220px; margin-bottom: 0; }
.sk-dot, .sk-line, .sk-block {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
    var(--dlt-border-soft) 25%, var(--dlt-border) 38%, var(--dlt-border-soft) 63%);
  background-size: 400% 100%;
  animation: sk-shimmer 1.4s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes sk-shimmer {
  from { background-position: 100% 0; }
  to { background-position: 0 0; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sk-dot, .sk-line, .sk-block { animation: none; }
}

/* ---- floating scroll-down cue ---- */
.dlt-next-anchor { height: 0; }
.dlt-scroll-cue {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 22px; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px);
  z-index: 50; display: grid; place-items: center;
  width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0;
  border: none; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--dlt-accent-soft); color: var(--dlt-accent-ink);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12); cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}
.dlt-scroll-cue.show {
  opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  animation: cue-bob 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.dlt-scroll-cue:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--dlt-accent-soft) 75%, var(--dlt-accent)); }
.dlt-scroll-cue svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
@keyframes cue-bob {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dlt-scroll-cue.show { animation: none; }
}

/* ---- Results table ---- */
.dlt-table-wrap { overflow: auto; height: 264px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; }
.dlt-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--dlt-font);
}
.dlt-table thead tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dlt-border); }
.dlt-table th {
  padding: 0 12px 8px; text-align: left;
  font: 600 11px/1 var(--dlt-font); color: var(--dlt-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase;
  vertical-align: bottom; white-space: nowrap;
}
.dlt-table td { padding: 7px 12px; color: var(--dlt-text); white-space: nowrap; }
.dlt-table tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dlt-border-soft); }
.dlt-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--dlt-accent-soft); }
.dlt-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.th-name { margin-bottom: 4px; }
/* mini distribution bar chart above column header label */
.spark { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; height: 20px; gap: 1px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.spark-bar { flex: 1; background: #b5a9f0; border-radius: 1px 1px 0 0; min-height: 2px; }
/* collapsible results — show 8 rows by default, expand on toggle */
.res-expand-cb { display: none; }
.res-collapsible tbody tr:nth-child(n+9) { display: none; }
.res-expand-cb:checked ~ .res-collapsible tbody tr:nth-child(n+9) { display: table-row; }
.res-foot {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding-top: 10px; font: 400 12px/1 var(--dlt-font); color: var(--dlt-muted);
}
.res-toggle {
  font: 500 12px/1 var(--dlt-font); color: var(--dlt-accent);
  cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
}
.res-toggle .lbl-less { display: none; }
.res-expand-cb:checked ~ * .lbl-more,
.res-expand-cb:checked + * .lbl-more { display: none; }
.res-expand-cb:checked ~ * .lbl-less,
.res-expand-cb:checked + * .lbl-less { display: inline; }
.dlt-muted { color: var(--dlt-muted); }
</style>
